note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI sent a fragile Lootas unit toward a screen point beside the enemy Custodians, about 33 inches away. It did not pick the friendly-side option that scored 8.43. Make a screen override fall back to the best scoring option when the screen scores below it.
